scripts.deploy: rm -rf deployment-package.zip .lambda-package && pnpm build && mkdir .lambda-package && cp -R dist/. package.json pnpm-lock.yaml .lambda-package/ && cd .lambda-package && pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile --config.node-linker=hoisted && zip -qr ../deployment-package.zip . -x pnpm-lock.yaml && cd .. && rm -rf .lambda-package
